senses.gloss: ch. sameto fence in; to check.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 90b:6">Yeb. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>מִיגְדַּר מילתא שאני</he> a measure to check something (an extraordinary measure for checking lawlessnes) is something different, allows of no analogies.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:2">Esth. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>גַּדְרָאנֵיה מן פורני</he> I will deduct it from my dowry. [<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:9">Ib. to I, 9</cite> <he>אנא מגדיר</he>, v. <cite ref="C01393"><he>גְּרַר</he></cite>.]
